id: title:adboio:only show task cost for user created tasks

review.posthog_relevance: Adds product origin metadata to the ContextUsageIndicator, supporting future tiered billing or usage attribution, but the score is capped at Tier 1 because the conditional cost calculation implementation and complete SessionView are missing, preventing verification of the actual billing behavior.
review.reason: The observed changes add an `originProduct` prop to the `ContextUsageIndicator` component, passing values like "user_created" or the task's origin product. This establishes a mechanism for distinguishing product origins in the UI. review.uncertainty: The tier cannot be established as Tier 2 or 3 because the core business logic (conditional cost calculation) and the complete view rendering are absent. The score is assigned only for the observable UI metadata change, not the unverified billing behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the conditional cost calculation or the complete SessionView component, so the exact behavior and tier cannot be established. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds originProduct prop to ContextUsageIndicator usage and its props.
